title: chitral-fan-screening: data and code for a fan-based evaluation of Melton-ratio and machine-learning screening of debris-flow and flood catchments in Chitral, Pakistan
description:
Analysis-ready dataset and complete analysis code for the paper Does Machine Learning Improve on the Melton Ratio? A Fan-Based Evaluation of Debris-Flow and Flood Process Screening in Glacierised Catchments of the Hindu Kush, Chitral, Pakistan (Hameed and Confuorto, submitted to Geomorphology).

The archive contains the 169 catchments of the Chitral district (Hindu Kush, Pakistan) with DEM-derived morphometry, climate, cryosphere and geology predictors and the mapped fan type at each outlet; the code that builds the dataset from the raw GIS layers; the spatial-block cross-validation benchmark of Melton-ratio rules, logistic regression, Random Forest and gradient boosting; the label checks; all results tables; and the figures of the paper.
